hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); report="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/reports/tf-drift-report.txt"; case "$cmd" in *'terraform apply'*|*'terraform destroy'*|*'-auto-approve'*) if [ -f "$report" ] && grep -q 'Overall Status: FAIL' "$report"; then echo 'BLOCKED: the latest Terraform drift review reported Overall Status: FAIL. Review and resolve the findings in reports/tf-drift-report.txt before any apply. Infrastructure-changing commands are run by the human, not by Claude Code.' >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; exit 0
